shortDescription: Bulk synchronize DNS record sets in Infomaniak DNS service

options.name: infomaniak_token
options.description: The token for Infomaniak's DNS API.

options.name: prune
options.description: If set to V(true), will remove all existing records in the zone that are not listed in O(record_sets).

options.name: record_sets
options.description: The records that should be present in the zone.

options.name: txt_character_encoding
options.description: Whether to treat numeric escape sequences (V(\\xyz)) as octal or decimal numbers. This is only used when O(txt_transformation=quoted). The default changed to V(decimal) in community.dns 3.0.0. Before, the default used to be V(octal). The value V(decimal) is compatible to L(RFC 1035, https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc1035.txt).

options.name: txt_transformation
options.description: Determines how TXT entry values are converted between the API and this module's input and output. The value V(api) means that values are returned from this module as they are returned from the API, and pushed to the API as they have been passed to this module. For idempotency checks, the input string will be compared to the strings returned by the API. options.name: zone_name
options.description: The DNS zone to modify. Note that the API does not allow to query by zone ID. Therefore, O(zone_id) is an alias of O(zone_name) for compatibility with modules and plugins for other providers.
